text:
viv: quick sync  i've sketched a compact header that combines a route hint + estimated units + a confidence score, trying to keep header count low for browsers. prototype: `X-RW-Client-Info: v1|rh=abcd1234|u=3|c=0.75`

lee: nice. can you show exact encoding & an example curl? we need to confirm no special chars that break proxies.

viv: example: ```curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-RW-Client-Info: v1|rh=abcd1234|u=3|c=0.75\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat``` it's pipe-separated ASCII, intentionally small.

omar: platform concerns: two things: 1) ingestion must parse reliably and map to fields `route_hint_id`, `client_units`, `confidence`; 2) dashboards must avoid double-counting. we'll index `units.client_est` separately.

hana: privacy/legal: before any client headers are sent from browsers we must have explicit consent. for Node/server SDKs consent can be config-driven without UI. browser SDK must default OFF and show a consent prompt.

viv: agreed. SDKs default OFF. we added `clientTelemetry: { enabled: false, consentRequired: true }` in constructor. browser SDK will expose `requestConsent()` helper.

lee: devex note: Go SDK has strict header canonicalization (http.Header) and some customers complained about header case-sensitivity in older proxies. use all-lowercase `x-rw-client-info` in examples to avoid confusion. add compatibility note.

omar: ingestion will canonicalize header names. also we need a `metering_schema` field so we can evolve encoding without breaking old events. add `client_info_schema=v1` in parsed meta.

hana: audit trail: legal wants a `consent_event` record emitted to audit stream when user gives consent in browser. SDK should POST a small beacon to ingestion endpoint with `consent_event=true`. ok?

viv: could do a lightweight fire-and-forget fetch to `/v1/client-consent` with org+anonymous flag. no PII. added opt-in in browser PR.

lee: console UX ask: add a chart overlay named \"Client hints (compact)\" off by default and a small adoption indicator showing percent of requests with `client_info` header. also add a \"Schema v1\" badge in the tile.

omar: aggregation rules: 1) server units = canonical for billing, 2) when overlay on show both lines but compute any combined aggregates using server units only, 3) provide a helper query `diff_client_vs_server(route, day)` to aid customers.

hana: retention question: how long do we keep `client_info` raw fields? legal suggests same retention as telemetry, but mark consented beacons in audit stream with longer retention.

viv: SDK compat: this is non-breaking opt-in => minor bump for TS/Go/Python. but Go's header example needs extra doc because older go clients sometimes upper-case. will add a compatibility section.

lee: ops: we need a canary plan. do server-side canary assignment; ingestion will tag `client_info_canary=true` for those orgs. please don't put rollout percent in SDK.

omar: backfill: we should NOT invent `client_units` for missing headers. instead run an adoption report and if customers request parity we can run a controlled backfill job, but only if they opt-in via console flag. add `client_compact_backfill` feature-flag per-org.

hana: legal: absolutely no implicit backfills for consent. backfill for counts only if org enabled and customer acknowledged in console. document required.

viv: telemetry: also want a small quality metric `client_hint_confidence_avg` per route daily. ingestion should emit daily rollups.

lee: tests: add unit parser tests, an integration e2e hitting local ingest proxy, and a lint rule verifying header length < 256 bytes.

omar: migration: ingestion will store parsed fields into `client_info_v1` object in raw event (schema v1). dashboards must read from `client_info_v1.units` not from raw header string. also add `client_info_present` boolean for adoption metrics.

hana: docs: include clear language in quotas & privacy pages: \"Client-sent estimates are advisory. Server-side counts and quotas remain authoritative. Browser client hints require explicit user consent.\"

ops-bot: CI: branch viv/compact-client-info queued. unit tests passed. flaky e2e retrying.

viv: final scheduling thoughts: ship SDK minor next week behind feature flag; ingestion parsing + index the week after; dashboard overlay + adoption tile on the following sprint. we'll keep overlay off by default and show a beta ribbon until adoption > 20%.

lee: +1. tagging followups: @omar (ingest parsing + rollups), @hana (consent audit + legal blurb), @ops-bot (canary monitoring), @viv (SDK PR + tests).

omar: will open the ingestion PR with schema docs and rollup job.

hana: will draft consent copy and the audit-runbook.

ops-bot: e2e retry succeeded, merge queued.
